findings.claim: dequeue() crashes with an unhandled ValueError when the queue is empty or contains no PENDING tasks, instead of returning None or raising a descriptive error.
findings.failure_scenario: Calling dequeue([]) (or dequeue(queue) where every task in queue is RUNNING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED/FAILED) makes `pending` an empty list; max(pending, key=...) then raises `ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence`, crashing the caller instead of signaling 'no work available' in any documented way.
